description: This file is a shell script (`.sh`) used for managing mTLS credentials and logging related to TLS operations in a device. It contains functions for logging, retrieving mTLS credentials based on device configuration, and includes sourcing external property files and other scripts.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS-related messages to the TLS log file with timestamp.

methods.name: getMtlsCreds
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate mTLS credentials based on device configuration, including static certificates, PKCS12 certificates, or fallback static certs. Exits with error codes if required files are missing.
